lines.en: I inch forward, segment by segment
My prolegs grip the leaf vein
I move to the other side of the leaf

lines.zh: 我慢慢地绕过虫咬的洞
lines.en: I slowly skirt a chewed hole

lines.zh: 我的身子一伸一缩地爬
lines.en: I inch along, stretching and bunching
I stop at the leaf's edge

lines.zh: 我沿着叶缘一路啃过去
lines.en: I chew my way along the leaf's rim
I crawl under the leaf; it's cooler
I arch my back and settle
I cross the midrib carefully

lines.zh: 我朝叶子更嫩的地方爬
lines.en: I crawl toward the tender part
I move to the leaf below
I'm slow, but I don't stop
I lift my head to probe ahead
I inch forward again
I stop in the middle of a fresh leaf

lines.zh: 叶背上的我，像一颗绿珠。
lines.en: On the leaf's back, I look like a green bead.

lines.zh: 我的背上有一排小突起
lines.en: A row of small bumps runs down my back
I raise my head and sway it
I'm chewing a leaf's edge
The leaf sways gently under me
I curl into a ball
I smell the leaf
Sun through the leaf is all green
This leaf will last two more days
My body is soft and heavy
Beside the vein I stay perfectly still.
I wait for it to get darker
Your shadow covers me whole
I raise my head and freeze
If I leave the leaf I'll starve
Could you move me over there
I clamp my prolegs on the vein
Your finger is enormous
I don't bite people
I'm not poisonous

lines.zh: 你把我捧起来吧，轻一点
lines.en: Cup me in your hand, gently

lines.zh: 你的手心比叶子暖多了。
lines.en: Your palm is much warmer than the leaf.
I curl into a ball and go still
I fall to the leaf below
I bury my head
I spin a little silk and hold
I slowly uncurl
My green looks a shade paler
A layer of green dust rubs off me.
I stay still a long while
I curl a little tighter
I don't dare eat again
That leaf looks good
Something tender; I can eat that
Set the leaf beside me
I stretch out and test it
This one's too tough
I nibble a ring around the edge
Don't wave your hand about
I can crawl across on my own
This will feed me a while
Thank you; I'll eat slowly
You touch me and I curl up

lines.zh: 我从叶子上滚下去一点
lines.en: I roll a little way off the leaf
I cling to your finger
I get nudged half a leaf over
The leaf bends under me
I drop onto a leaf below
I haul myself up, segment by segment

lines.zh: 你又碰了一下，我缩得更紧
lines.en: You touch again and I curl tighter
I crawl onto the back of your hand
It's warmer than the leaf

lines.zh: 另一条在旁边的叶子上
lines.en: Another is on the leaf beside me
We look at each other across the vein
Its stripes are darker than mine
We each eat our own leaf
It crawls faster than I do
We chew the leaf's edge side by side
Our leaves are very close
I turn my head toward it
We're both slow
This wood has enough for both
I hug it with my front legs
It's heavier than a leaf
I test it with my mouth
It isn't a leaf; I won't eat it
I can't hold it; it drops
I nudge it carefully
It's blocking my way
I go around it
It smells of leaves
I'll leave it alone
Something keeps watching me
I clamp every proleg to the leaf.
I tuck my head under my body
I don't dare move at all
Off the leaf, I'll die
I crawl to the far side of the leaf
I spin silk and hold on
The leaf shakes; I cling
I move and it looks
Then I won't move
I curl up like a dropping
A hand comes and I curl tighter
I retreat to the stem
I weigh the leaf down
My silk still holds

lines.zh: 它一碰，我就掉下去装死
lines.en: One touch and I drop and play dead
I slowly half-turn
It stops, and so do I
I wait for it to leave
I haven't finished this leaf
I butt my head at it

lines.zh: 我的身体一弹，撞在手指上
lines.en: I snap my body against a finger

lines.zh: 我吐出的丝黏在它指节上。
lines.en: My silk sticks to its knuckle.
It pushes and I roll half a turn
I bite its sleeve
I wrap silk on its finger

lines.zh: 这一下我把自己也甩下去了
lines.en: That flung me off too
I hang from a thread of silk
It doesn't touch again, so I crawl back

lines.zh: 我用背上的突起顶它的手指。
lines.en: I push the knobs on my back against its finger.

lines.zh: 叶背下多了一小团东西
lines.en: A small lump appears under the leaf
I inch out from behind the vein

lines.zh: 叶子被压得往下弯了一点
lines.en: The leaf dips a little
I stop in the middle of the leaf

lines.zh: 这片叶子边缘有旧咬痕
lines.en: This leaf has old bite marks

lines.zh: 森林的叶子这么多，够我吃到结蛹。
lines.en: So many forest leaves; enough until I pupate.
I'm green enough to vanish
I'll stay here and eat slowly
I move to the sunlit part
I crawl in from the stem's end

lines.zh: 叶子被点着，我赶紧往下爬
lines.en: The leaf catches fire; I hurry downward

lines.zh: 我从叶子上掉下去，落在草里
lines.en: I fall off the leaf into the grass
Water soaks me and I can't move
The blast flips every leaf

lines.zh: 箭把叶子穿了个洞，就在我旁边
lines.en: An arrow punches a hole right beside me

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的身体僵住
lines.en: That force stiffens my body

lines.zh: 这片叶子被吃光了，我还没饱
lines.en: This leaf is finished and I'm not full

lines.zh: 雷光一亮，整棵树都在抖
lines.en: A flash of lightning and the whole tree shakes
No leaf below to fall on
